title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Juniors 2026 in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's junior squad is undergoing intensive training at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati ahead of the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This initiative by BAI aims to elevate the standard of badminton coaching across India, directly impacting player development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course across two national centers, aiming to enhance coaching standards.

title: Indian Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp brought together India's promising U17 and U15 players for focused training ahead of a key continental championship.
summary: A national coaching camp was held at the NCE Guwahati for the Indian junior team preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.

title: Final Selection Trials for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This announcement detailed the pathway for India's junior players to represent the nation at the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI released the eligibility criteria and list of players qualified for the final selection trials for the BWF World Junior Championships.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This major scoring system change will significantly impact junior badminton development and strategy across India.
summary: BAI announced the adoption of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
